results.name: 3D Infinite Runner
results.shortDescription: infinite-runner-3d (or endless runner) is a type of 3D platformer game where the player character runs continuously through a procedurally generated, ever-changing 3D environment. The primary objective is to last as long as possible by dodging obstacles, collecting coins or power-ups, and performing other actions to achieve the highest score before falling or hitting an obstacle.

results.name: Last War Zombie Frontline
results.shortDescription: Last War: Frontline is a fast-paced action-puzzle mode within the strategic world of Last War: Survival. You control rapid-fire units to strategically blast through barriers, recruit new soldiers, collect powerful weapons, and expand your army to conquer challenging, multi-stage levels and dominate the battlefield.
results.longDescription:
Last War: Frontline (also known as "Frontline Breakthrough") is an intense mini-game within the popular strategy title, Last War: Survival, which is a blend of Merge and Tower Defense gameplay set in a zombie apocalypse.

In the Frontline mode, the focus shifts to a tactical, rapid-fire sequence. Your goal is to strategically use your firepower to break barrels and obstacles to quickly recruit more soldiers and acquire powerful temporary weapons. You must make split-second decisions on which numbered barriers to attack to maximize your troop count, as a larger army is essential for defeating the final boss of each level and progressing through the ever-more-challenging frontline. It offers a unique, challenging experience that helps you boost your overall power in the main game.

results.longDescription:
Fruit Ninja Game
Short Description

Experience the thrill of slicing and dicing fresh fruit in this fast-paced action game! Swipe your finger across the screen to slash through flying fruits while avoiding dangerous bombs. Test your reflexes and aim for the highest score in this addictive arcade-style game that's easy to learn but challenging to master.
Long Description & How to Play
Overview

Fruit Ninja is an exciting arcade game that challenges players to slice through various fruits using swift finger movements. The game combines quick reflexes, precise timing, and strategic thinking as you aim to achieve the highest possible score while avoiding obstacles.
How to Play

Basic Controls:

    Swipe your finger across the screen to create slashing motions
    Each swipe acts as a blade that cuts through any fruit it touches
    You can perform multiple slashes in quick succession for combo attacks

Gameplay Mechanics:

    Fruits are launched into the air from the bottom of the screen in random patterns
    Different fruits appear with varying point values (watermelons, apples, oranges, pineapples, etc.)
    Slice as many fruits as possible before they fall off the screen
    Missing three fruits will end your game
    Special golden fruits provide bonus points when sliced

Obstacles to Avoid:

    Bombs: Black explosive devices that end your game instantly if sliced
    Bombs often appear mixed with fruits, requiring careful precision
    Use short, controlled swipes near bombs to avoid accidental contact
